sourceText: Mr. Utterson was sitting by his fireside one evening after dinner, when he was surprised to receive a visit from Poole.

attempts.label: primary
attempts.visibleOutput:
TRANSLATION: lon tenpo pimeja wan, moku li pini la, jan Utason li awen lon poka seli. jan Pulu li kama lukin e ona la, ni li nasa tawa jan Utason.
NOTES: NONE
